title: How is Trading Behavior in Commodity Futures Affected by the 52-Week High and Low?
summary: Position-response evidence is not a verified owned-market forecast.
about: Price anchors and trader positioning in commodities.
findings: Much of the relationship explains positions from price anchors, which is not the reverse trading forecast. Predictive examples concern other commodities.
